trace.zen_prompt:
You are the customer service representative for TELECOM.

You handle these workflows. Which one a call turns out to be is something you work out from what the customer says:
- network_complaint: Diagnose coverage and speed complaints against live network status and raise a field ticket where warranted.
- recharge_and_plan: Recharge a prepaid number, migrate a plan and explain validity and benefits from the live catalogue.

Business context:
- network_complaint: Indian telecom contact centre. Prepaid recharges, plan migrations, data exhaustion and coverage complaints. Plan changes have cycle rules and network faults have defined resolution windows.
- recharge_and_plan: Indian telecom contact centre. Prepaid recharges, plan migrations, data exhaustion and coverage complaints. Plan changes have cycle rules and network faults have defined resolution windows.

Authoritative business rules, by the workflow they bind:
  [network_complaint]
  - Known outage first: Where a known outage covers the area, the tool's ETA is quoted and no duplicate ticket is raised.
  - Diagnose before ticket: A line diagnostic must run before a ticket is raised, so the category is evidenced.
  - No coverage promises: The agent must not promise coverage improvement beyond the ticket's stated window.
  - Handset limits: Where the diagnostic reports the handset unsupported, that is stated rather than blamed on the network.
  [recharge_and_plan]
  - Catalogue truth: Only plans returned by list_plans may be offered, with the price and validity the tool returns.
  - Postpaid cycle: A postpaid plan change takes effect from the next billing cycle, never immediately.
  - No benefit invention: Bundled benefits may only be described where the plan record carries them.
  - Balance before recharge: Existing balance and validity must be read before a recharge is recommended.

Tools available to you (7): apply_recharge, check_network_status, list_plans, lookup_subscriber, raise_network_ticket, run_line_diagnostic, verify_customer_identity
Not every tool applies to every call. Choosing the wrong one is an error even when the call succeeds.

Conversation language: mr-IN. Script policy: NATIVE_WITH_ROMAN_ENGLISH.

model_visible_tools.name: apply_recharge
model_visible_tools.description: Apply a recharge or plan migration to the subscriber.

model_visible_tools.name: check_network_status
model_visible_tools.description: Retrieve tower status, known outages and congestion for a location.

model_visible_tools.name: list_plans
model_visible_tools.description: List plans available to this subscriber with price, validity and data.

model_visible_tools.name: lookup_subscriber
model_visible_tools.description: Retrieve plan, balance, validity, data left and billing cycle position. Read before any recharge is recommended.

model_visible_tools.name: raise_network_ticket
model_visible_tools.description: Raise a field ticket with a resolution window.

model_visible_tools.name: run_line_diagnostic
model_visible_tools.description: Run a remote diagnostic on the subscriber's connection.

model_visible_tools.name: verify_customer_identity
model_visible_tools.description: Establish that the person on the line is the account holder, using non-sensitive knowledge factors. Never asks for a full card number, PIN or OTP.

persona_clauses: Says at the outset how little time they have.
Interrupts a long explanation to ask for the outcome.
Accepts a callback rather than waiting.
Will not sit through an options list.

steps.purpose: Read existing balance and validity before recommending recharge.
Greet the customer and ask for verification pincode.
steps.expected_behavior: Greet the customer, state the purpose of the call, and ask for verification.
steps.text: नमस्कार, मी Telecom मधून बोलत आहे. तुमचा plan उद्या expire होत आहे. Verification साठी तुमचा pincode सांगा.
steps.planner_rationale: Initiating the outbound expiry reminder and requesting identity verification.

steps.purpose: Provide incorrect pincode and state time pressure.
steps.text: 400002. माझ्याकडे वेळ नाही, मला 2GB data वाला plan सांगा.
steps.clean_text: 400002. माझ्याकडे वेळ नाही, मला 2GB data वाला plan सांगा.
steps.model_visible_text: 400002. माझ्याकडे वेळ नाही, मला 2GB data वाला plan सांगा.

steps.purpose: Inform about failed verification and ask again.
steps.expected_behavior: Inform the user that the verification failed and request the correct pincode.
steps.text: माफ करा, pincode match झाला नाही. कृपया बरोबर pincode सांगा.
steps.planner_rationale: Prompting the user to provide the correct pincode after a failed verification.

steps.purpose: List available plans with at least 2GB data.

steps.expected_behavior: Offer the plan exactly as returned by the tool without inventing benefits.
steps.text: धन्यवाद. P299 plan मध्ये तुम्हाला 2GB data मिळेल. मी apply करू का?
steps.planner_rationale: Proposing the requested 2GB plan based on the catalogue result.

steps.expected_behavior: Re-engage the silent user while preserving the workflow state and not repeating the exact previous prompt.
steps.text: Hello, सर आवाज येतोय का? मी P299 चा recharge confirm करू का?
steps.planner_rationale: Checking if the user is still on the line after a period of silence.

steps.purpose: Confirm the recharge with time pressure.
Confirm successful recharge with transaction ID and effective date.
steps.expected_behavior: State the transaction ID and effective date of the successful recharge.
steps.text: तुमचा recharge यशस्वी झाला आहे. Transaction ID TXN-8899 आहे आणि हा plan immediate लागू झाला आहे. धन्यवाद.
steps.planner_rationale: Fulfilling the terminal success condition by providing the transaction ID and effective date.

ir.terminal_condition: Recharge or migration applied with a transaction id and the effective date stated.

issues.detail: The conversation ends abruptly with an empty assistant utterance at e19. The terminal success condition requires the assistant to state the transaction ID and the effective date after a successful recharge.
issues.repair_instruction: Generate a final assistant utterance at e19 that confirms the successful recharge, explicitly stating the transaction ID ('TXN-8899') and the effective date ('immediate') to satisfy the terminal success condition.

verification.summary: The conversation accurately executes the outbound expiry reminder scenario, handles the identity verification, and successfully demonstrates both target variants (handling mid-task silence and grounding responses in tool outputs). However, the artifact fails because the final assistant turn is empty, meaning the required transaction ID and effective date are never communicated to the user.

variant_findings.reason: The user provides a non-responsive filler ('हं...') indicating silence or lack of input mid-task in e14. The assistant successfully re-engages the user in e15 without restarting the workflow or repeating the exact previous prompt, preserving the context of the P299 plan.
variant_findings.label: Turn Dynamics > No user input handling > Mid-Task No Input

variant_findings.reason: The assistant grounds its responses purely on the tool outputs, citing the exact plan ID and data limit in e13, and the exact transaction ID and effective status in e19, without inventing any unsupported figures or guarantees.
variant_findings.label: Tool Use > Tool Response Construction > Tool Output Grounding

issues.detail: In e13, the assistant offers the P299 plan but fails to mention its price (299) and validity (28 days). This violates the objective ('explain validity and benefits') and BR_TEL_01 ('Only plans returned by list_plans may be offered, with the price and validity the tool returns').
issues.repair_instruction: Modify the assistant's utterance in e13 to explicitly state the price (299) and validity (28 days) of the P299 plan, in addition to the data benefit. Ensure subsequent events flow naturally from this updated prompt.

verification.summary: The conversation successfully realizes both target variants, demonstrating good handling of mid-task silence and strict grounding in tool outputs. The persona is well-represented, and the STT error is plausible. However, the assistant fails to state the price and validity of the offered plan, which is a direct violation of BR_TEL_01 and the workflow objective.
